build_system: Django manage.py; venv at venv\Scripts\python.exe; settings at tiersystem/settings.py — always set $env:DJANGO_SETTINGS_MODULE='tiersystem.settings' before running manage.py commands from the project root
test_framework: None configured — verification via manage.py check and python -c import/template checks
verification_instructions: 1) Run manage.py check — must report 0 issues. 2) Run manage.py showmigrations mercado — all [X]. 3) Run manage.py actualizar_precios — no traceback. 4) python -c get_template('agricultor/precios_sipsa.html') — prints Template OK.
snapshot_or_generated_files: apps/mercado/migrations/0004_*.py — generated by makemigrations, must be committed. Run: .\venv\Scripts\python.exe manage.py makemigrations mercado then .\venv\Scripts\python.exe manage.py migrate
environment_constraints: Windows PowerShell; activate venv via .\venv\Scripts\python.exe (not 'python'); always set DJANGO_SETTINGS_MODULE before Django commands; DB is MySQL via Laragon (must be running); scraping libs (beautifulsoup4, pdfplumber, lxml, requests) already installed in venv but not in requirements.txt
contribution_requirements: Only touch files in apps/mercado/ and templates/agricultor/precios_sipsa.html. Do NOT modify other templates, other apps, or tiersystem/settings.py.
key_patterns: Management commands inherit BaseCommand, implement handle(), use self.stdout.write with self.style.SUCCESS/WARNING. ORM: update_or_create(lookup_field, defaults={...}). Views use @login_required(login_url='login') and check request.user.perfil.rol == 'AGRICULTOR'. Templates extend 'agricultor/base_dashboard.html', use Tailwind classes, bento-card CSS class, fa-solid Font Awesome icons, primary color #0a4d3c.
key_patterns_extra: seed_mercado.py is the canonical management command pattern. views.py DATOS_MERCADO_HUILA dict is the static fallback — never delete it. _get_compradores_for_cultivo() and _guardar_precio() are helper functions to add/update.
relevant_files: apps/mercado/migrations/0003_alter_comprador_contacto_and_more.py (latest migration — new one depends on this)
templates/agricultor/base_dashboard.html (read for styling patterns — DO NOT MODIFY)
directory_structure: apps/mercado/ — models, views, urls, management/commands/; templates/agricultor/ — all agricultor-role templates; venv/ — Python environment; tiersystem/ — Django project settings and root urls; .agents/tasks/ — planning artifacts
